dedupe_keys.name: fema nfip multiple loss properties repetitive and severe repetitive loss structures openfema

description: The NFIP Multiple Loss Properties dataset lists structures that have had several National Flood Insurance Program claims over the history of the programme, covering the four Repetitive Loss and Severe Repetitive Loss categories that FEMA tracks under the NFIP and the Flood Mitigation Assistance programme. It held 240,651 records when read (last refreshed 4 August 2026) with state, county, ZIP code, community, census block group, the four loss category flags, flood zone, rounded coordinates, occupancy type, original construction date and new business date, post-FIRM and primary residence flags, whether the structure is currently insured or has been mitigated, total losses and the most recent date of loss; it includes properties since mitigated or demolished. Coverage: United States, 1978 onwards. Access: free API, CSV and an online map. Licence: OpenFEMA terms. Caveats: location is redacted, and FEMA notes that poor historical addresses mean missing coordinates and that statistics may differ from other FEMA reports. Simulation uses: locating chronically flooded buildings for flood risk, buyout and mitigation prioritisation models. Related records: NFIP Redacted Claims and NFIP Redacted Policies.
